The '''Pyolli system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|dessert]] known as [[Pyollian cake]].<ref name="Operation Elrood">[[Operation: Elrood (book)|''Operation: Elrood'']]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Pyollian cake]]s|system=Pyolli [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Pyolli system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-18.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> On the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]], Fry noted that Pyolli was the last addition to the Appendix of the ''Atlas'', a section listing over 4,300 [[Star/Legends|star]] systems.<ref name="EA">{{JCFCite|url=posts/29882250|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-03-17|time=3:40 PM|quote=4,348 star systems and other galactic phenomena, from [[23 Mere system/Legends|23 Mere]] to [[Zznza system/Legends|Zznza]]. Let posterity show that the final placement was Pyolli, determined to be in the Seswenna sector.}}</ref>
